name: Her Heart's Desire: A Landlord Epic
source:
Her Heart's Desire is a choice-driven adult visual novel focusing on the best parts of dating. After renting out your spare bedrooms, romance your new tenants, publisher, her secretary, and other gorgeous women. Your fun filled journey with laughter, drama, and sex awaits! This completed game includes an ending with each of the three primary love interests, or go for all three and get the harem ending. Your Landlord Epic begins today!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/bigchungusproductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Her Heart's Desire》是一部由選擇推動的成人視覺小說，專寫約會中最令人心動的部分。把閒置的臥室租出去之後，你可以追求新房客、你的出版商、她的秘書，還有其他迷人的女性。一路上有歡笑、有波折，也有性愛！本作已完結，三位主要戀愛對象各有自己的結局，你也可以同時追求三人，迎來後宮結局。屬於你的房東傳奇，從今天開始！
